Cleanarr, maintained by Michael Murphy. A self-hosted tool that reclaims disk from Radarr and Sonarr using watch history from Tautulli, Tracearr, and Jellystat, plus request data from Seerr.
This repository, including the Unraid templates, metadata, and docs, is MIT licensed. Support and source: https://github.com/michaelmurfy/cleanarr/issues
